offering_description.value: Sells weight-management, nutrition, sports performance, and skin and body care products to consumers through independent distributors. It develops products through scientific research and gives distributors programs and product guidance to help them support customers.

quotes.quote: Welcome to Herbalife USA - global leaders in weight management, health & nutrition, fitness & performance, skin & body care products. Join us today!

Our science-backed nutrition products are offered exclusively through our network of Herbalife Independent Distributors. As global ambassadors of our brand, these dedicated entrepreneurs support their customers through a passion for health and nutrition and by sharing their own wellness journeys. Herbalife’s team of experts supports our Herbalife Independent Distributors with programs, product guidance and other informational materials to help their customers. Herbalife Independent Distributors also have a supportive community of fellow Distributors to help them reach their customers.
